does.text: Runs CreateDummies and then DeleteDummies each frame.

Client-side builder of photo-mode character dummies. It looks at eoc::photo_mode::DummyComponent entities added this frame (the server's replicated request for a dummy), skips a source entity that a live ecl::dummy::DummyComponent already refers to, filters on the current multiplayer user and photo-mode session (UserComponent + eoc::photo_mode::SessionComponent query), then for each collected candidate creates a new entity through the deferred command buffer, adds ecl::dummy::DummyComponent to the new entity (holding the source entity) and ecl::dummy::HasDummyComponent to the source entity (holding the new one). It also keeps a DummiesCreatedSingleton record.
